messages:
Anya Patel: Quick idea — can we experiment with a shorter ARB format for the next 6 weeks? Proposing 30m core + 15m overflow. Core would be strict: 10m RFC triage, 10m design review, 10m action items/rollouts. Overflow for deep dives or blocked items.
Matt Johnson: 30m core sounds good to me — keeps things focused. How do we handle pre-reads?
Anya Patel: Pre-reads 24h prior ideally. I can paste a tiny agenda template we can copy into threads: 
```
Agenda (30m core):
- RFC triage (10m) — quick accept/reject/needs-work
- Design review (10m) — max 1 presenter, 5 slides or 1 pager
- Rollouts & ops (10m) — blockers, canary plans
Overflow (15m): deep dive if needed or follow-ups
```
Sofia Ruiz: Love the template. Suggest we rotate facilitator + note-taker weekly (facilitator 30m run, note-taker adds TL;DR in thread). I can take facilitation next Wed.
Dmitri Ivanov: +1 for rotation. Also request: tag reviewers 48h before meeting so folks have time. Some RFCs need specific reviewers (runtime, infra).
Leo Chen: timezone note — next Wed I'm in APAC and 11am PT is 2am for me. Can we pick a window that alternates between mornings and afternoons so global folks get occasional reasonable times?
Anya Patel: Good catch Leo. Proposal: alternate Weds 11am PT and Weds 4pm PT every other week. That gives folks outside NA at least one meeting at friendly hours biweekly. Thoughts?
Matt Johnson: Works for me. Can we add a one-click poll? e.g., https://polls.company/arb-cadence (can someone create?)
Sofia Ruiz: I'll make the poll. Also, for RFC triage: please add a 1-line status at top of RFC: "ready/needs-work/blocked" so we can triage fast.
Dmitri Ivanov: Agree. Also call out the model variant and infra impact section in the RFC template — saves back-and-forth.
Anya Patel: Ok action items: 1) Sofia create poll for alternating cadence; 2) I'll update ARB agenda template in the handbook; 3) Sofia to take facilitator next Wed; 4) add 48h reviewer-mentions on RFCs; 5) Leo we'll mark alternating week as low-impact for APAC when possible.
Leo Chen: I can take note-taking the week after Sofia.
arb-bot: Reminder: facilitator rotation set to "opt-in" until we have a 6-week pattern.
Matt Johnson: Small nit: can we cap design-presentations to 5 slides or a 5-minute demo plus Q&A? Keeps schedule tight.
Sofia Ruiz: Yep, will add to the template: presenter limit = 5 slides or 5m demo.
Anya Patel: Great — if no objections I'll update the recurring invite to 30m core + 15m overflow and set alternating times. Will post updated agenda template in #eng-platform handbook.
Dmitri Ivanov: No objections from me.
Matt Johnson: +1
Leo Chen: +1
Sofia Ruiz: +1, will do poll and send calendar change after results.
Anya Patel: Thanks all — please drop any agenda items for next Wed's meeting in this thread before EOD Tuesday.
Matt Johnson: pinging @runtime-team for a quick slot on a perf regression RFC.
Sofia Ruiz: noted, adding to roster.
Anya Patel: Closing note: if anyone wants to shadow facilitator this month LMK — we can make facilitator pair-ups for the first two rotations.
